scene: The tram screeches to a halt at Grand Station. Where to next?
picture: In a bustling tile-floored station concourse, a sleek blue subway train waits with doors open on the left. The young Black woman in yellow raincoat, green boots, and red umbrella stands mid-left. A bright yellow street tram idles at centre. A red glass cable car hangs ready up high on the right.
